newsitem.title: USA: Owens-Illinois files $2.5 bln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Owens-Illinois files $2.5 bln shelf offer.

text.p: Owens-Illinois Inc filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration of up to $2.5 billion in debt securities, guarantees and common shares.
The shelf offering includes $100 million registered from a previous offering, the Toledo, Ohio, packaging company said in a filing late Monday.

The company said it will use the proceeds from the shelf offering for general corporate purposes, which may include financing working capital needs, capital expenditures and refinancing outstanding debt.
No underwriters were named in the filing.
